**Answer**

The theme song from the movie *Arthur* is performed by **Christopher Cross**.  
The single was issued on **Warner Bros. Records**, which is a subsidiary of **Warner Music Group** (WMG).

**Owner of the label**

*Warner Music Group* is majority‑owned by **Access Industries** (72 % equity, 98 % voting power).  
Access Industries is controlled by **Len Blavatnik** (founder of the conglomerate).

| Entity | Owner / Parent | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Warner Bros. Records | Warner Music Group | Major‑label subsidiary |
| Warner Music Group | Access Industries | 72 % of shares, 98 % of votes |
| Access Industries | Len Blavatnik | Founder and controlling stakeholder |

**Sources**

* Christopher Cross – “Arthur’s Theme (Best That You Can Do)” is a single by Cross released on Warner Bros. Records【6†L43-L51】.  
* Warner Music Group – The company’s owner is Access Industries, which holds 72 % equity and 98 % voting power【5†L20-L26】.  
* Access Industries – Founded and led by Len Blavatnik【5†L12-L18】.

So, the owner of the record label that Christopher Cross (the singer of the *Arthur* theme song) is part of is **Len Blavatnik**, via his holding company Access Industries.
